name: search
title: Search treg Catalog
description: Find catalogued endpoints by the job you need done, with prices and success rates.

name: call
title: Call treg Tool
description: Make the real upstream request to a catalogued endpoint id through treg.to and see what it cost.

rest.description: Catalogued endpoint id (e.g. moz.web.url.metrics), a team tool as name/path, or an upstream URL.

method.description: HTTP method; defaults to POST when a body is given, else GET.

body.description: JSON body (object, or a JSON string that gets parsed).

max_cost_usd.description: Per-call ceiling in USD, sent as X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost.

idempotency_key.description: Send on a retry of a maybe-charged timeout: same key replays the stored answer free.

meta.description: Attribution tags, "customer=c1, feature=x" or an object.

name: balance
title: treg Balance
description: Show the treg team's billing and balance.

routes.name: endpoint
routes.description: Get a catalogued endpoint's parameters, price, reliability and a ready call line. Token-free.

endpoint_id.description: Endpoint id from the catalog, e.g. treg.web.backlinks.list.

routes.name: search
routes.description: Search the treg catalog by the job you need done. Token-free.

q.description: What you want done, e.g. "backlinks for a domain" or "text to video".

added_within_days.description: Only tools added within the last N days.
